PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Yalladakere Village of Hiriyur Taluk, Chitradurga
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Thalavarahatti,
Nayakarakottige and Badagollarahatti as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chitradurga
District.

along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of JANEKUNTE Village of BALLARI Taluk,
BALLARI District and to constitute a new revenue villages called JANEKUNTE
THANDA as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and
new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of JANEKUNTE Village of BALLARI Taluk, BALLARI district to form a
new revenue village called as JANEKUNTE TANDA Village of BALLARI Taluk,
BALLARI District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

here by makes the following notification, namely:-

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RC-CFS0ADMN/197/2024-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E- 1308566 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date: 02-02-2024

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience , the Government of Karnataka proposes to after, the extent
of residential area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the
boundary of Kodihalli Village of Kotturu Taluk of Vijayanagara District, to convert
the existing Boranahalli unrecorded habitation in to a hamlet/extension /part of the
existing revenue village. The area occupied by the said hamlet of the village is specified
in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Kodihalli Village for conversion of Sutta Kodihalli unrecorded habitation in to hamlet/
extension/ part of the said revenue village.
Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be
affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after
thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Vijayanagara
District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column (3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Sutta Kodihalli village of Kotturu
Taluk of Vijayanagara District convert the same to form hamlet/extension within the
boundary of Kodihalli Revenue village and same will herein after be named as called
Sutta Kodihalli of Kodihalli village in Kotturu Taluk of Vijayanagara District.

administrative convenience the, Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a

of Tumkur District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Bandenahalli
Gollarahatti as specified in schedule.

specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Junjuramanahalli village for conversion of Bandenahalli Gollarahatti unrecorded
habitation in to hamlet of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said

affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after
thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur
District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of MANNURU SUGURU Village of SIRUGUPPA
Taluk, BALLARI District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
DODDARAJA CAMP as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of SIRUGUPPA Taluk of BALLARI District to form a new revenue village
called DODDARAJA CAMP Village of SIRUGUPPA Taluk, BALLARI District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of DARUR Village of SIRUGUPPA Taluk, BALLARI
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called DARUR CAMP as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of SIRUGUPPA Taluk BALLARI District to form a new revenue village called
DARUR CAMP Village of SIRUGUPPA Taluk, BALLARI District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Avaradi Village of Mudalagi Taluk, Belagavi
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Hale Yaragudri as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Belagavi District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Mudalagi Taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village called as
Hale Yaragudri of Mudalagi Taluk and Belagavi district along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Makhanapur Village of Vijayapur taluk ,Vijayapur
District and to constitute a new village called Khushab Nagar, Narashimha Nagar as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected

thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Vijayapur District.

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Vijayapur taluk ,Vijayapur District to form a new revenue village called as
Kushyaba Nagar of Vijayapur taluk ,Vijayapur District along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Kallambella Village of Sira Taluk, Tumkur District
and to constitute a new revenue villages called Kenchaganahalli, Kallambella
Banglae,Mallashetihalli, Lakkanahalli as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 939 kamgrara 2017
Dated:23-01-2018 regarding altering the limits of Kotta village of Sira Taluk and
Tumkur District and constituting a new revenue villages called Mustigarahalli
,Aadaluru, Rangapura ,Lingadahalli and Bommarasanahalli was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 939 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:05-04-2018
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 12-04-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Kotta of Sira taluk in Tumkur District to form a new revenue village called as
Mustigarahalli of Sira taluk Tumkur District along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 940 Kamgrara 2017
Dated:22-12-2017 regarding altering the limits of Ratnasandra village of Sira Taluk
and Tumkur District and constituting a new revenue villages called Yaragunte,
Ratnasandra Gollarahatti,Kadire Kambadahalli, Kempanahalli was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 940 Kamgrara 2017 Dated:08-02-2018
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 15-02-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Ratnasandra of Sira taluk in Tumkur District to form a new revenue village
called as Yaragunte of Sira taluk Tumkur District along with the survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.
